Hi Marta — thanks for sending this over. High level checklist below — I'll flag marketplace-specific differences after.

Immediate items we need from Nebula (vendor intake checklist):
1) Signed W-9 (if Nebula is US-based) or W-8BEN/8BEN-E for non-US entities. Please ensure the legal name matches your IRS registration.
2) Remit-to / AP email (accounts-payable@nebula.tech) — we'll add this to our vendor record.
3) Preferred payor name for POs (legal entity that will accept PO and invoice). If different across marketplaces, please specify per-marketplace.
4) Completed PO Payor Mapping Template (see attached) — populate one row per marketplace (AWS/Azure/GCP) with payor, tax id/EIN, remit address, and any required MCC.
5) Bank wiring instructions (if your finance team prefers wires over marketplace billing flows).

Marketplace notes:
- AWS Marketplace: Redwood typically accepts a single payor on our side but the clearing entity on AWS sometimes requires the Seller's tax id for the listing. We'll need the mapping file to determine if AWS listing should be billed to Nebula or billed via Redwood with pass-through reconciliation.
- Azure Marketplace: Often requires the payor on the PO to match the Azure reserved purchase entity — many customers prefer customer PO to Redwood and invoice Redwood (we can support either).
- GCP Marketplace: Payor fields are more flexible, but if you plan to use GCP Marketplace private pricing, we may need a separate payor mapping entry.

Attachments: PO_Payor_Mapping_Template.xlsx (please fill and return).

Next steps:
- Marta: return signed W-9 and the completed mapping template by EOD Thur 12/3 if possible.
- Vanessa (cc'd): will open an internal procurement ticket and confirm PO routing once the mapping is in.

I'll follow up internally once I have the completed template.

Best,

- For AWS: payor = Nebula Tech Inc., EIN = 12-3456789, remit-to = accounts-payable@nebula.tech, MCC = 5734
